# GUSI

GUSI is a modern Eastern European restaurant with Mediterranean influences located at 432 Sixth Avenue in Greenwich Village, New York City.

GUSI offers modern interpretations of Eastern European comfort food, hand folded dumplings, seasonal borscht, house made spreads, Georgian wine, natural wine, handcrafted cocktails, and house infused vodka.

## Key Information

Location: 432 Sixth Avenue, New York, NY 10011
Neighborhood: Greenwich Village
Phone: +1 646 370 5413
Website: https://gusi.nyc/
Reservations: Available through the reservation links on the website
Private events: Dedicated private dining space for events and celebrations of up to 70 guests
